messages:
Priya: Kicking off int8 canary for quasar13b (lite) on 2xA100. Hitting mem-frag spikes and occasional OOMs for long summaries. Also noticed drop in ROUGE and more hallucinations in the news-summ eval. Logs and config below, need actionable plan.

Sam: paste logs + current runtime config? Any recent changes to prefetch/batching compared to fp16 baseline?

Priya: logs:
```
[2026-03-10T08:12:02Z] WARN allocator: memfrag_ratio=0.74
[2026-03-10T08:12:02Z] INFO kv: prefetch_candidates=24
[2026-03-10T08:12:03Z] ERROR inference: allocation failed during kv_prefetch -> OOM
[2026-03-10T08:12:03Z] INFO compactor: evicted 4 slots reclaimed=1.3GB
```
runtime config (canary):
```json
{"quant":"int8","batch_size":8,"max_new_tokens":256,"prefetch_kv":true,"kv_eviction_threshold":0.6,"slot_compactor":"enabled"}
```
Repro locally on same instance type; fragmentation climbs around 120-160 tokens.

Lee: Quick mitigations: lower batch_size and max_new_tokens, disable prefetch to reduce jitter, tighten kv_eviction_threshold, add small warmup_prefix to stabilize early allocations. Proposed canary params: batch_size=2, max_new_tokens=128, prefetch_kv=false, kv_eviction_threshold=0.45, warmup_prefix=32. Also enable kv_trim_on_pause.

Mara: Did eval comparison yet? I ran a small sweep: fp16 baseline (quasar13b-lite) ROUGE-L=0.64 hallucinations=2.8% on news-summ. int8 canary (current config) ROUGE-L=0.57 hallucinations=9.1%. Same prompts/seeds. Directory: evals/news/2026-03-10/quasar-int8/

Sam: Hypothesis: int8 quant path + prefetch changes allocation layout and timing of KV caches; when combined with larger batches it produces allocation churn and occasionally stale KV pointers during prefix handling -> manifests as context corruption and hallucination. Two-pronged approach: (1) operational: throttle canary by reducing batch_size/max_new_tokens and disabling prefetch; (2) runtime: add a lightweight guard that monitors first-token logprob / kv_hit_rate and triggers fp16 fallback for suspicious requests. Also set generation_window=128 and max_gen_chunk=32 to reduce long-window retains.

Priya: I've applied Lee's proposed params on canary. After ~1k requests: memfrag ratio reduced to ~0.46, no OOMs so far. Quality improved: ROUGE-L=0.60 hallucinations=5.2% (better but not at fp16 baseline).

Lee: Rollout plan: keep quantized canary live but restrict traffic to <=5% and keep conservative defaults (batch_size=2, max_new_tokens=128). Add eval alert: if hallucination_rate > 6% on nightly eval job, rollback route to fp16 for that model. Also add an observability hook for tail token logprobs and kv_hit_rate.

Priya: Sam, can you add a temporary runtime gate to fallback to fp16 if first_token_logprob < -7.5 OR kv_hit_rate < 0.25? That should catch the noisy cases without full rollback.

Sam: Yep, will open ENG-ML-8421 to implement fallback gate + metric hooks (tail logprobs, kv_hit_rate, memfrag_ratio). ETA: EOD tomorrow. I'll add a canary-only toggle so we can flip quickly.

Mara: I'll run an extended eval (2k samples) with the new canary settings including conversational prompts and long articles to see residual gap and failure modes. Will post results in this thread.

Priya: Thanks — tagging rollout artifact quasar13b-int8-canary-20260310 and will hold traffic at 5% until evals green. Posting smoke test results once completed. :white_check_mark:
